titre: His queen is attacked. Does White run? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Sicilian, Bb5+ line. After 7...Nfd7?, both knights are pinned. 8.Nxe5! leaves the white queen hanging: 8...Bxd1 9.Bxd7+ Qxd7 10.Nxd7 Kxd7 11.Rxd1+ and White is a piece up. 7...Bd7 was better for Black. Seen in 4 real Lichess games (puzzle rating ~1776). Checked with Stockfish. Would you have saved your queen? 👇
